test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P is taller than Q and R is taller than S. If S is taller than Q but shorter than P and P is shorter than R, who is the tallest?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) P is taller than Q.

P > Q

2) R is taller than S.

R > S

3) S is taller than Q but shorter than P and P is shorter than R.

R > P > S > Q

Thus, R is the tallest in all.

Hence, the correct answer is **"R".**
